q1: SELECT MAX(NUM) AS NUM FROM (SELECT NUM FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY NUM HAVING COUNT(NUM) = 1) AS T
q2: SELECT ( SELECT IFNULL(NUM,NULL) FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY NUM HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 ORDER BY NUM DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS NUM
